svg.title: Featured projects
svg.desc: Seasonal Demand Forecasting: Prophet model forecasting festival & wedding-season demand, using a custom festival-proximity regressor. Pathfinding Visualiser: Dijkstra, A*, BFS and DFS on weighted & unweighted graphs, rendered step by step as terminal graphics.
